activities.activity: Waking up, showering, brushing teeth and getting ready
Making and eating breakfast, boiling water for tea
Changing into work clothes and packing bag for the day
Working at the nonprofit office: coordinating community programs, answering emails and attending planning meetings
Taking a lunch break and eating lunch
Continuing work at the office: preparing program materials, meeting with partner organisations and updating community schedules
Washing dishes and tidying up the kitchen
Relaxing on the sofa, watching TV
Taking an evening shower and completing night-time hygiene routine
Winding down in bed, using the desk lamp to read and check the next day's schedule
